beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A writing judge may reward length because longer answers once happened to be better.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Padding can break that connection while the judge keeps agreeing with itself.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Repeatability therefore differs from measuring the quality the task actually requires.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Likewise, instructions inside a candidate must not acquire authority over its assessment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When evidence is missing, a useful judge can abstain and request further review.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A meaningful appeal preserves the evidence and rules needed to challenge a verdict.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book develops these responsibilities across software, science, education, and institutional decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with Rubric Engineering and Decomposition to see how standards become operational.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow the harness and governance chapters to examine what happens after scoring.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it when choosing an evaluator also means deciding how much authority to delegate.
